description: Assessment and payment of annual Real Property Tax (RPT) on land, buildings, and machinery in Roxas City, offering up to 20% prompt-payment discount for early settlement.
steps: Present previous year's Official Receipt or Tax Declaration number at the City Assessor / Treasury Window, Roxas City Hall.
Receive statement of account detailing current year tax due and applicable prompt payment discount.
Pay in cash, manager's check, or authorized electronic banking channel.
Receive official receipt and tax clearance validation.
requirements: Previous Year Official Receipt of RPT payment
Valid Government ID of property owner or authorized representative

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Real property owners in Roxas City

description: Issuance of Community Tax Certificate (Individual or Corporate) required for notarized documents, government transactions, and business clearances in Roxas City.
steps: Fill out Cedula information slip at the Treasury assessment counter, City Hall or participating Barangay Hall.
State declared gross income or earnings from business/profession for the preceding year.
Pay basic tax (₱5.00) plus additional tax based on gross income (₱1.00 per ₱1,000 earnings).
Affix signature and thumbmark, and receive original Community Tax Certificate.
requirements: Proof of gross income (Payslip, ITR, or Certificate of Compensation if applicable)

quickInfo.fee: Statutory minimum ₱5.50 plus proportional income assessment
quickInfo.whoCanApply: Individuals aged 18 and above residing or employed in Roxas City

sources.name: Local Government Code of 1991 / City Treasury Office
